info.title: Risk Cloud API (Legacy v1) — Auth
info.description:
The Risk Cloud API is a collection of RESTful API endpoints that empower you and your team to directly integrate, automate, and build with the Risk Cloud. Risk Cloud API endpoint payloads are JSON based, with some endpoints supporting exports in CSV and XSLX formats for flexible integration.

This API documentation showcases our Risk Cloud API v1, containing a variety of endpoints with continued support for enabling integrations with the Risk Cloud.

Visit the [LogicGate Risk Cloud Developer Portal](https://www.logicgate.com/developer/) to get started with building your custom integration with quick start guides, usage guides, release notes, and more. Or download the [v1 OpenAPI specification](/legacy-openapi.json).

Explore our [Risk Cloud API v2](https://docs.logicgate.com/v2/index.html) endpoints and documentation as well. [Risk Cloud API v2](https://docs.logicgate.com/v2/index.html) is our collection of API-First endpoints that are tailor made for our developer users, offer concise and highly documented details, are supported by a [Postman collection](https://www.postman.com/logicgate-postman/workspace/logicgate-risk-cloud-api/collection/29257227-de8d264b-6eeb-4177-bea6-2da0a8cabffc) and [v2 OpenAPI specification](https://github.com/LogicGateTech/openapi), and contain our latest API endpoint releases.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description:
A basic authorization header containing a Risk Cloud API access token in the format `Authorization: Basic ENCODED` — replace `ENCODED` with your base64-encoded Client Key:Secret Key credentials.

To obtain a Risk Cloud API access token, refer to [Obtain an API Access Token](https://www.logicgate.com/developer/risk-cloud-api-authentication/) in the [LogicGate Help Center](https://help.logicgate.com/hc/en-us).

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description:
A bearer authorization header containing a Risk Cloud API access token in the format `Authorization: Bearer TOKEN` — replace `TOKEN` with your actual access token.

To obtain a Risk Cloud API access token, refer to [Obtain an API Access Token](https://www.logicgate.com/developer/risk-cloud-api-authentication/) in the [LogicGate Help Center](https://help.logicgate.com/hc/en-us).

post.summary: Create a new user-managed API token
post.description: Creates a named API token for the current user and returns the plaintext access token and refresh token exactly once. Neither can be recovered from the server afterward, so the caller must persist both values before navigating away. The refresh token can be used against POST /api/v2/account/token to obtain a fresh access token without re-creating from the UI.

delete.description: Revokes the specified API token owned by the current user. Responds with 404 if the token does not exist or is owned by another user. The response is the same in both cases to avoid leaking the existence of other users' tokens.
